acceptanceCriteria.text: Return-visit survey only fires after 30s+ of active gameplay
No survey fires within first 10s of page load
Mechanic-specific surveys only fire after those mechanics are used

snapshot.description: Surveys appear too early. Return-visit survey fires 3s after load on 2nd session regardless of game state. Need to gate all surveys behind actual gameplay engagement and increase minimum delay.
snapshot.title: Fix survey triggers: gate surveys behind mechanic use

changes.newValue: Added _gameEngagementTs flag set on first game message. maybeTriggerMicroSurvey and maybeTriggerFirstMissionSurvey both gate on 30s engagement. maybeShowReturnVisitSurvey now checks every 15s starting at 30s (not 3s). Removed early setTimeout.
